experiment_A_authoritative.name: Demand Regression
experiment_A_authoritative.objective: Predict monthly spare-parts demand (actual_qty) per material and plant for inventory control.
experiment_A_authoritative.why_it_ranked_first_verbatim: ContextFlow ranked candidates on the holdout root_mean_squared_error it was given as primaryMetric. ExtraTreesMSE scored 172.503385, the lowest of the 11 candidates; WeightedEnsemble_L2 was second at 174.086569 and NeuralNetTorch third at 178.123274. The margin over second place is 1.583184 RMSE = 0.91%. No model was chosen by a human; bestCandidateId is what the engine returned.

holdout_diagnostics_verbatim.WARNING: These diagnostics are computed for WeightedEnsemble_L2 (rmse 174.086569, r2 0.711535), NOT for the rank-1 winner ExtraTreesMSE (rmse 172.503385, r2 0.716757). The diagnostics block's rmse/r2 match rank 2 exactly. Any WAPE quoted for 'the ContextFlow model' is therefore the runner-up's WAPE, not the champion's.

endpoint.live_check: POST predict returned 200 with numeric predictions on 2026-11-04T18:10:21Z — the endpoint serves.

experiment_B_second_run.name: Demand Regression
experiment_B_second_run.significance: A SECOND experiment is deployed and in_service on the same asset and the same analysisId, trained on the same 6,000-row file but with domainType 'general' and a 3-model curated plan. It is materially worse (RMSE 232.885196 vs 172.503385; WAPE 0.598288 vs 0.477518; r2 0.483766 vs 0.716757). Two in_service endpoints exist. The dashboard must name the experiment id it reads, or it can silently serve the weaker model.

task_is_regression_not_classification.evidence: dataset.problemType = 'regression' and endpoint.problemType = 'regression' on both experiments; probabilities = null and decisionThreshold = null on the live predict response; the diagnostics block is kind='regression' with residuals and r2, not a confusion matrix.

target_is_a_quantity.evidence: targetColumn = 'actual_qty' on the dataset and on the deployed endpoint; the live predict response returns targetColumn 'actual_qty' with continuous values (1290.1533203125, 10.850000381469727). Holdout actuals include 0 and -1, consistent with a net-demand quantity rather than a class label.

model_chosen_by_contextflow_not_by_us.evidence: bestCandidateId is returned by the engine and matches endpoint.candidateId on both experiments. No champion/approve_champion call was made by this cell.

six_month_holdout.evidence: splitStrategy = 'deterministic_random_holdout', holdoutFraction = 0.2, diagnostics rows = 1200 of 6000. That is a RANDOM 20% holdout, not the time-ordered 6-month holdout the brief requires. A random split over a time series leaks future months into training: rows from 2025-12 can sit in train while 2024-03 sits in test. The reported WAPE is therefore an optimistic in-sample-period number and is NOT a 6-month-ahead forecast accuracy.
six_month_holdout.what_the_holdout_should_have_been: 2025-07..2025-12, which in the verified step-2 grain is 5,283 of 30,861 cohort-month rows (17.12%) and 937,113.778 base UoM of net demand.

horizons_3_6_9_12.evidence: No horizon parameter exists anywhere on either experiment. The model is a tabular regressor over a 'month' feature, not a horizon-aware forecaster. Horizons can only be produced by calling predict once per future month; nothing in ContextFlow records them.

grain_material_x_plant_x_month.verdict: FAIL — the deployed model cannot express it
grain_material_x_plant_x_month.evidence: featureColumns do not include MATERIAL_ID. Confirmed empirically: two predict rows identical except MATERIAL_ID 'MAT-000001' vs 'MAT-005999' both returned 1290.1533203125 — byte-identical. The model is blind to material. The finest grain it can distinguish is the 7-way cohort (PLANT x CATEGORY x MATERIAL_GROUP x MATERIAL_TYPE x CRITICALITY x MOVEMENT_CLASS x SHUTDOWN_FLAG), which HANA confirms is 2,027 distinct cohorts covering 34,717 material-plant lines. The step-2 SQL header states this limitation and is correct to do so.
grain_material_x_plant_x_month.consequence_for_the_dashboard: The brief's SUCCESS criterion — drill Plant -> Material Type -> Material Group -> Material and see a forecast quantity — cannot be met at the Material level from this model. A material-level number would be the cohort number repeated, and must be labelled as an allocation, not a forecast.

metrics_wape_mape_rmse.caveat_rmse: WAPE and the rmse in the diagnostics block belong to WeightedEnsemble_L2 (rank 2). The champion ExtraTreesMSE's own holdout RMSE is 172.503385 and r2 0.716757.
metrics_wape_mape_rmse.caveat_mape: MAPE is UNCOMPUTABLE on this data. The leaderboard's own mean_absolute_percentage_error for every candidate is of order 1e15 to 5e16 (e.g. ExtraTreesMSE 1.85e15) because the target contains zeros — HANA confirms 154 zero and 242 negative cohort-months in the in-scope grain. The diagnostics MAPE of 1.927361 is computed on a different denominator set. Report WAPE; label MAPE UNCOMPUTABLE with this reason.

dimensions_plant_materialtype_materialgr.evidence: PLANT_ID, MATERIAL_TYPE, MATERIAL_GROUP are all featureColumns and are used (importance 29.727418 / 49.450405 / 154.389918). MATERIAL is absent — see grain finding above.

qty_accuracy_kpi_1_minus_wape.status: RED — 52.2% against a >90% target, and that is the optimistic random-split figure, not a 6-month-ahead one.

extrapolation_test.method: Identical cohort, month varied, against the live endpoint 6ae894a219423a530ab79f69.
extrapolation_test.finding: The model accepts months outside the 2024-01..2025-12 training range without error and returns plausible-looking numbers. 2099-06 returns 1397.11669921875 — exactly the same value as 2026-06. A tree ensemble cannot extrapolate beyond its training range; it flattens onto the nearest learned leaf. Forward months are not trend-extrapolated, they are the nearest in-sample month's leaf value.
extrapolation_test.consequence: Forward forecasts from this model are a seasonal/level replay of 2024-2025, not a projection. A 12-month-ahead number carries no more information than a 1-month-ahead one. This must be stated on the Demand Forecast page; a silent forward curve would be misleading.

verdict.overall: BLOCKED — the ContextFlow evidence does not yet support the forecast the brief specifies.
what_is_sound: The forecast INPUT grain is correct and reconciles to step 1 to the decimal.
ContextFlow is the engine; the model was selected by the engine on a declared metric; the task is regression and the target is a quantity. All three brief validations pass.
The champion endpoint is live and serving.
blocking_defects: D1 — holdout is a random 20% split, not the required time-ordered 6-month holdout. Reported accuracy is optimistic and is not forecast accuracy.
D2 — the published WAPE/RMSE in the diagnostics block belong to rank 2 (WeightedEnsemble_L2), not to the rank-1 champion (ExtraTreesMSE). Quoting them as 'the model's accuracy' is wrong.
D3 — MATERIAL_ID is not a feature. Material-level forecasts are impossible; the SUCCESS drill-down cannot be met at the Material level from this model.
D4 — tree ensemble cannot extrapolate. 2099-06 returns the same number as 2026-06. Forward horizons are a replay, not a projection.
D5 — two in_service endpoints on the same asset with a 35% RMSE gap. The dashboard must pin an experiment id.
D6 — Qty Accuracy (1-WAPE) is 52.2% against a >90% target, on the optimistic split.
verdict.recommended_resolution: Re-run the experiment with a time-ordered holdout on 2025-07..2025-12 and MATERIAL_ID either added as a feature or the material grain formally descoped and labelled. Until then no forecast number should reach the dashboard without the banner the brief requires.
